video_title: “It's Good To See How This Team Handles Adversity.” | Ayo Dosunmu Postgame Sound | 10.14.26

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the Timberwolves' need for better team physicality
quotes.excerpt: we just got to just do a better job as a team to just be stronger
quotes.quote: We just got to just do a better job as a team to just be stronger, set screens for each other and create opportunities for each other to be able to get downhill, not just to score but to create actions and get the defense moving side to side. They put on initial defense, physical, but once we get it moving side to side, that's the challenging part when you play so high and physical like that.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu says the Timberwolves need to be more physical and move the ball side to side to counter aggressive defenses. He notes the team must do a better job to create opportunities and get the defense moving.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on building team chemistry during the preseason
quotes.excerpt: we have the bond, we've been having a lot of chemistry
quotes.quote: We are coming together great. We have the bond, we've been having a lot of chemistry, but at the same time, adversity is going to come and I think we faced a little bit of that in this preseason. As the season starts, there's going to be adversity. It's not always going to be easy sailing, so we just have to keep staying together as a group, keep our camaraderie high, keep our spirits high, keep competing and just keep taking it one game at a time.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on the preseason grind: Adversity is going to come and it is not always going to be easy sailing. The focus for the team is to keep camaraderie high and take it one game at a time.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the Timberwolves' positionless point guard committee
quotes.excerpt: we just got to do a job as getting into actions
quotes.quote: We just got to do a job as getting into actions. I think we can play off of each other because when we get a rebound, we all can run. We just got to keep creating advantages and just really just getting us into actions. I think that's the main thing, being able to bring the ball up right away and get into an action around 20 so we can get a good shot up.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu emphasizes the need for the Timberwolves to get into their offensive actions early. He says the goal is to bring the ball up and initiate sets around the 20 second mark to ensure good shots.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the team's positionless basketball approach
quotes.excerpt: it's a positionless basketball and we have so many different sets
quotes.quote: It's a positionless basketball and we have so many different sets, so I can't say it's going to be one primary ball handler. It could be TJ, it could be Bones, it could be me, it could be Ant, it could be LaMelo. We have so many different sets and it all depends on who's getting the shot, who's creating the shot, who we want in the action. All those variables can change.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu confirms the Timberwolves are running a positionless offense. He notes there is no primary ball handler, with duties shared by himself, TJ, Bones, Ant, and LaMelo depending on the set.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the importance of film study for defensive improvement
quotes.excerpt: continuing to watch film, continuing to learn what areas we can improve on
quotes.quote: Continuing to watch film, continuing to learn what areas we can improve on and continuing to just lock into the game plan. As we're winding down to end this preseason, each and every game is going to be much more detailed scout. We did a little bit this game, but all the games going forward is going to be detailed scout. What do they like to do? What are their strengths, weaknesses, tendencies? All of that. I think that's going to help us also.
quotes.social_post: As the preseason winds down, Ayo Dosunmu says the team is shifting focus toward more detailed scouting reports to better understand opponent strengths, weaknesses, and tendencies.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on Rudy Gobert's offensive development
quotes.excerpt: he's someone who's very vital for us on both ends
quotes.quote: He's been doing great this preseason, just trying to encourage him to take that momentum into the regular season. He's someone who's very vital for us on both ends, of course, especially in that pick and roll. When they're blitzing, we have to hit him in the pocket. Him being able to make those passes, he threw a great dump down pass. He understands that, he made his free throws today. I think that's very important for him.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu is encouraged by Rudy Gobert's offensive growth this preseason. He highlights Gobert's improved passing out of the pocket when teams blitz and his importance to the team on both ends.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on avoiding stagnant, one-pass possessions
quotes.excerpt: what got us bogged down the second half was one pass one shot
quotes.quote: We have to do a better job as a committee in terms of not necessarily just kahooning and make sure he gets shots, but making sure we keep the ball moving. What got us bogged down the second half was one pass one shot and no one can catch a rhythm like that. So we just have to do a better job of understanding, okay, we just had three or four bad possessions where we didn't get the defense moving side to side.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu identifies stagnant offense as a key issue for the Timberwolves. He says the team got bogged down in the second half because of one pass possessions that prevented anyone from catching a rhythm.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on his shooting preference from deep
quotes.excerpt: I do like above the break threes because I think that you got a little more space
quotes.quote: I don't know. I never really had a preference. I definitely do like above the break threes because I think that you got a little more space. The corner is more tight, but sure, the two to the corner is shorter. So I don't know, but I do like above the break threes.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu shares his shooting preference, noting he likes above the break threes because he feels there is a little more space compared to the tighter corner shots.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the team's long-term goal of building a brotherhood
quotes.excerpt: in order for us to reach our goals, it's going to take a committee
quotes.quote: They want to compete, they want to win, we have a brotherhood. We understand that in order for us to reach our goals, it's going to take a committee. It's not going to happen overnight. We have to just continue, I say, just make championship habits and they both want to win, they both want to go far in this. So it's just good to be around them and go through the process.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu says the Timberwolves are focused on building a brotherhood and championship habits. He emphasizes that reaching their goals will take a committee effort and cannot happen overnight.
